name: aTV Remote

description.fr_FR: aTV Remote - Permet de commander vos Apple TV et vos HomePod (lecture, pochette, volume, télécommande) - restera en BETA longtemps !
description.en_US: aTV Remote - to command your Apple TVs and HomePods (playback, artwork, volume, remote) - will stay in BETA for a long time!
description.es_ES: aTV Remote - Controla tus Apple TV y HomePod (reproducción, carátula, volumen, mando) - ¡estará en BETA durante mucho tiempo!
description.de_DE: aTV Remote - Ermöglicht die Steuerung Ihrer Apple TV und HomePods (Wiedergabe, Cover, Lautstärke, Fernbedienung) - wird lange in BETA bleiben!
description.it_IT: aTV Remote - Controlla le tue Apple TV e i tuoi HomePod (riproduzione, copertina, volume, telecomando) - rimarrà in BETA per molto tempo!
description.pt_PT: aTV Remote - Controla as tuas Apple TV e os teus HomePod (reprodução, capa, volume, comando) - vai ficar em BETA durante muito tempo!

utilization:
Apple TV (3, HD, 4K) et HomePod (HomePod, HomePod mini, mini 2).

ATTENTION : Debian 12 minimum. Non supporté : Debian 11 et plus ancien & Docker & Jeedom Mini+ & Raspberry Pi 1-2 & Raspberry Zéro (armv6) & i386 (32bits)

Pas de bouton micro (Siri) Voir documentation.
